twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration module

Comprehensive integration test for Phase 2 implementation.

This test validates that the ontology-driven model builder correctly: 1. Interprets the ontology structure 2. Creates proper primitive instances 3. Wires relationships correctly 4. Produces expected observables 5. Supports discovery-based learning

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_ontology_structure_compliance()[source]

Test that our ontology follows proper TBox/RBox structure.

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_primitive_instantiation_from_ontology()[source]

Test that primitives are correctly instantiated from ontology classes.

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_relationship_wiring()[source]

Test that relationships from RBox are correctly wired.

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_observable_emission()[source]

Test that primitives emit observables as defined in ontology.

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_controllable_parameters()[source]

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_monitor_kpi_tracking()[source]

Test that monitor tracks KPIs defined in ontology observables.

twin_model.tests.test_phase2_integration.test_scheduler_order_management()[source]

Test that scheduler can manage orders as defined in ontology.
